Supporting foundation: Free coherent monad modules and their augmented free resolution. Supporting lemma: Conditional universal-arrow criterion for a coherent free module.

title: Conditional universal-arrow criterion for a coherent free module
statement:
Use quasicategories, coherent functors, mapping spaces and universes of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and monoidal infinity-categories of [def-coef-monoidal-infinity-category]. Let $\mathcal V$ be a monoidal infinity-category and $\mathcal M$ an infinity-category with a coherent left action $\otimes:\mathcal V\times\mathcal M\to\mathcal M$: the equivalences $(v\otimes w)\otimes m\simeq v\otimes(w\otimes m)$ and $\mathbf1\otimes m\simeq m$ include all associative and unital higher compatibilities. An associative algebra $B$ in $\mathcal V$ has a multiplication $B\otimes B\to B$, a unit $\mathbf1\to B$ and their coherent compatibilities. A left $B$-module in $\mathcal M$ has an action $B\otimes m\to m$ with all coherent associativity and unit data; $\operatorname{LMod}_B(\mathcal M)$ retains the coherent action-preserving maps and their higher simplices. All categories and mapping spaces are taken in sufficiently large universes. Let $X\in\mathcal M$, let $L\in\operatorname{LMod}_B(\mathcal M)$ have action $b_L$, let $U$ forget the action, and let $\lambda:X\to UL$ be a morphism. Suppose the composite
$$B\otimes X\xrightarrow{B\otimes\lambda}B\otimes UL\xrightarrow{b_L}UL$$
is an equivalence. Then for every $N\in\operatorname{LMod}_B(\mathcal M)$ the map
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{LMod}_B(\mathcal M)}(L,N)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal M}(X,UN),\qquad f\longmapsto U(f)\lambda$$
is an equivalence of spaces, natural in $N$ and in coherent families of pairs $(L,\lambda)$. No existence of $L$ is asserted without the displayed hypothesis, and no colimit or presentability hypothesis is imposed.
